name: agent-relay
description: Local, least-privilege delegation between coding agents through a guarded stdio MCP router.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate local agent work with receipts
interface.longDescription: Coordinate local coding agents without copy and paste or public tunnels. Exact project roots, read-only defaults, loop prevention, and verifiable tool receipts are built in.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Relay to ask Claude for a read-only plan, then implement the approved change in Codex.
Use Agent Relay to get an independent local agent review and return its completed receipt.
